}}'''Holcom''' is a soldier of the [[Tower Guard]].{{ref/book|14|27}}

== Appearance ==
Holcom is a spindly man, and has a face like a horse.

== Activities ==
During the [[Last Battle]], Holcom is sent to give [[Gareth Bryne]] a status report while they fight in [[Kandor]]. After he delivers the message, Bryne sends him to [[Denhold]] with instructions to beef up the left flank.{{ref/book|14|27}}

== Trivia ==
* Holcom is named for Andrew Holcombe, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
